name: e07_vision_only_on_off
role: DESCRIPTIVE comparison: Kalman ON vs Kalman OFF when BOTH are strictly vision-only (camera + own commands; no leader speed, speed sensor or heading). Not a confirmatory test.
notes: Detector best_realistic_v2.pt. on_pv = VisionRangeTracker, q=6 from d05_vo_tune. off_short_pv = production Kalman-OFF controller; leader speed from low-passed finite differences (tau 1 s from d05_vo_tune), own speed from the same command model. Same laps, dropouts and seeds as e05 plus huge waves, and two speed-change cases with the e06 seeds. No tuning on these seeds.
